whatIs: Toolfolio is a curated library of tools and resources for AI agents, with dedicated sections for MCP servers and skills. It also covers design, programming, no-code, productivity, marketing and security, with themed collections and articles that compare tools.
You use it with the search bar (⌘K) or by browsing categories and collections. Each listing says whether the tool is free, freemium, paid or one-time purchase.
uses: Finding an official MCP server to connect Figma or Calendly to your AI agent.
Looking for ready-made skills to extend what a coding agent can do.
Comparing design or productivity tools within a themed collection.
caveats: There are paid sections to promote startups, marked with a paid listing label, as well as discount coupons.
There's no full view of the catalog and no filters by attribute: you explore by category.
Each tool has its own pricing, which can change.
pricingNote: The directory is free to use; the listed tools are free, freemium or paid, and the site sells featured listings.
idealFor: Anyone looking for MCP servers, skills and tools for working with AI agents.
